describes: request envelope identity and the sourceAnalysis request object read by sourcePathOf
groundedIn: bend2/context/bend2/native-provider.mjs validateInvocation (invocationShape, invocationVersion, invocationIdentityKind, invocationIdentityMissing, requestKind)

members.cwd: non-empty string; realpath must equal the launch working directory (requestCwdMismatch otherwise)
members.subject: object with non-empty string path (absolute, or resolved against cwd)

name: baton2.context.bend2.source-analysis.subject.v1

refusals.invocationIdentityKind: query/owner not strings, or role/incarnation neither null nor string
refusals.invocationIdentityMissing: query or owner empty (null role/incarnation normalize, they never refuse)
refusals.requestKind: request is null, an array, or not an object
refusals.requestMalformed: request is null, an array, or not an object
refusals.sourcePathMissing: subject not an object or subject.path not a non-empty string

unknownMembers: ignored, never refused; the reader takes cwd and subject.path only
version: version member of the envelope is the number 2
